result.narrative:
Nordkrans Steel Traders AB scores 47.7, placing it in the Watch band with a PD of 0.3767. The payment file, as of 2026-08-31, shows two open invoices with Nordhaven Trade Credit (CL05) totalling EUR 218,600, the worst 25 days past due on an invoice of EUR 150,700. Settled history is deteriorating rather than stable: days late across the last four settled invoices ran 0, 3, 0, then 13. Open exposure of roughly EUR 219k sits well inside the EUR 1.46m limit, but that limit was last reviewed in November 2024, so the headroom is not evidence of comfort. Against that, a live report dated 2026-09-20 says the company has missed payroll for a second consecutive month, with union talks stalled.

The band is built from 0.65 x 33.3 (payment, 25 DPD) + 0.35 x 74.3 (news) = 47.7. The news leg contributes 26.0 of those points; payment contributes 21.7. The adjudicator agreed with the Watch band but attached caveats, and they matter here. LIVE01 is a single point of failure: strip it out and the score is 21.7, which is Healthy, below the 35.0 line. Its sourcing is thin for a severity 5 rating, resting on three workers at the Malmo yard speaking to the paper, with no management, union or filing confirmation, and carried by a publication recorded as "Live input". The only other news is NWS0027 and NWS0028, 787 and 498 days old, both severity 0 and both decayed to 0, so nothing independently corroborates distress. The adjudicator also notes the payment leg is dated 2026-08-31, twenty days before the payroll report, so 25 DPD may be a stale snapshot scored against live news.

The recommendation is REDUCE on LIM0025 with Nordhaven Trade Credit: cut the limit from EUR 1,460,000 to EUR 968,941, being the limit at which expected loss meets the 25% appetite against a PD of 0.3767. Expected loss falls from EUR 420,736 to EUR 279,225. The revised limit still sits far above the EUR 218,600 currently owed, so the cut removes unreviewed drawdown capacity rather than constraining live trade. Given the adjudicator's caveats, the reduction should go alongside verification of the payroll report and a refreshed payment file before the score is leaned on further.

What lifts this is straightforward. If LIVE01 cannot be verified, the news leg falls away and the buyer is Healthy on the payment record alone — the score needs to drop 12.7 points to cross below 35.0, and news alone does not hold the band. Clearing the EUR 150,700 invoice and returning settled invoices to on-time would reverse the 0→3→0→13 trend that is driving the payment leg. Absent verification, the news signal decays on a 365-day half-life, so time alone will erode it slowly.
